title: Convey Ideas
sub: Express opinions, suggest ideas and argue your point.

cards.def:
to put forward an idea for consideration
हिंदी: प्रस्ताव रखना
examples: I propose a new schedule.
She proposed a merger.
I propose that we meet every Friday to review progress.
The committee proposed a new dress code for the office.

cards.def:
to offer an idea for discussion
हिंदी: आगे रखना
examples: She put forward a bold idea.
He put forward a new plan.
Several teams put forward names for the new product.
In the meeting, she put forward a plan to cut travel costs.

cards.def:
to offer an idea to test reactions
हिंदी: विचार उछालना / आज़माने हेतु रखना
examples: He floated the idea of a four-day week.
Let me float an idea.
I floated the idea of a team trip, and everyone liked it.
She floated an idea about flexible hours in the town hall.

cards.def:
to present an idea to win support
हिंदी: अपना विचार प्रस्तुत करना
examples: She pitched her idea to investors.
I'll pitch it on Monday.
The startup pitched its app to three investors last week.
He pitched a new training programme to HR.

cards.def:
to share many ideas casually
हिंदी: विचारों का आदान-प्रदान करना
examples: We threw around a few ideas.
Let's throw around ideas.
We threw around ideas for the party over lunch.
The team threw around ideas for a new logo.

cards.def:
to think of an idea or plan
हिंदी: सोच निकालना
examples: She came up with a clever plan.
Can you come up with a better idea?
We need to come up with a name for our new shop.
He came up with an excuse for being late again.

cards.def:
to think creatively
हिंदी: लीक से हटकर सोचना
examples: We need to think outside the box.
Try to think outside the box.
Think outside the box to find cheaper ways to market the product.
The teacher encourages students to think outside the box.

cards.def:
to test ideas by discussing them with someone
हिंदी: किसी से विचार परखना
examples: I'd like to bounce ideas off you.
She bounced it off the team.
Can I bounce ideas off you before the client meeting?
I bounce ideas off my sister when I plan trips.

cards.def:
to cause an idea to start
हिंदी: विचार की चिंगारी देना
examples: The talk sparked an idea.
A chat sparked the idea.
A customer complaint sparked an idea for a new feature.
Her question sparked an idea in my mind.

cards.def:
an extremely clever idea
हिंदी: शानदार विचार
examples: That's a brilliant idea.
She had a brilliant idea.
Ordering pizza for the late shift was a brilliant idea.
He came up with a brilliant idea to save on electricity.

cards.def:
a clever or good idea
हिंदी: अच्छा सुझाव
examples: Whose bright idea was this?
I have a bright idea.
Then someone had the bright idea of asking the customers.
Do you have any bright ideas for the farewell gift?

cards.def:
something worth thinking about
हिंदी: सोचने को मजबूर करने वाली बात
examples: His speech gave us food for thought.
That's some food for thought.
The documentary on plastic waste gave me food for thought.
Your feedback is food for thought for the whole team.

cards.def:
a thought came to my mind
हिंदी: मेरे मन में आया
examples: It occurred to me that we could save money.
It occurred to me yesterday.
It occurred to me that I hadn't called my parents this week.
It never occurred to me to ask for a discount.

cards.def:
explaining the purpose
हिंदी: विचार यह है कि
examples: The idea is to cut costs.
The idea is to simplify the process.
The idea is to finish the work before the holidays.
The idea is to let customers order without signing up.

cards.def:
explaining the reasoning
हिंदी: सोच यह है कि
examples: The thinking is that users prefer simplicity.
The thinking is we should wait.
The thinking is that a smaller office will save rent.
The thinking is that customers will pay more for faster delivery.

cards.def:
the reason for a decision
हिंदी: ... के पीछे का तर्क
examples: The rationale behind it is cost.
What's the rationale behind this?
The rationale behind the new rule is customer safety.
Can you explain the rationale behind the price change?

cards.def:
explaining the reasoning
हिंदी: तर्क यह है कि
examples: The logic is that fewer steps mean fewer errors.
The logic is simple.
The logic is that happy employees serve customers better.
The logic is clear: fewer meetings, more focus time.

cards.def:
my view or interpretation
हिंदी: इस पर मेरी राय
examples: My take on this is to wait.
What's your take on this?
My take on this is that we should hire, not outsource.
What's your take on the new office policy?

cards.def:
according to my opinion
हिंदी: मेरी दृष्टि में
examples: In my view, we should expand.
In my view, it's too early.
In my view, the movie was too long.
In my view, we should wait for the client's reply.

cards.def:
as I think
हिंदी: मेरी राय में
examples: In my opinion, it's a good plan.
In my opinion, we must act.
In my opinion, the new metro line will help a lot.
Everyone has a right to their opinion; in my opinion, we're ready.

cards.def:
from my point of view
हिंदी: जैसा मैं देखता हूँ
examples: As I see it, there are two options.
As I see it, we're ready.
As I see it, the real problem is poor planning.
As I see it, we have no choice but to delay.

cards.def:
from my viewpoint
हिंदी: मेरे नज़रिए से
examples: From my perspective, it's risky.
From my perspective, it's fair.
From my perspective, the change makes our work easier.
From my perspective as a parent, school fees are too high.

cards.def:
I get the impression
हिंदी: मुझे लगता है
examples: It seems to me that we're late.
It seems to me he's right.
It seems to me that the customer just wants an apology.
It seems to me that you need a break.

cards.def:
I believe
हिंदी: मुझे लगता है कि
examples: I feel that we should wait.
I feel that it's unfair.
I feel that we should give him another chance.
I feel that the meeting was rushed.

cards.def:
I think something is true
हिंदी: मेरा मानना है
examples: I believe we can do it.
I believe it's the right choice.
I believe the shop opens at ten.
I believe hard work always pays off.

cards.def:
I'm certain
हिंदी: मुझे पूरा यक़ीन है
examples: I'm convinced that this will work.
I'm convinced that he's right.
I'm convinced that this new tool will save us hours.
She's convinced that she left her keys at the office.

cards.def:
I am very sure
हिंदी: मेरा दृढ़ विश्वास है
examples: I strongly believe in teamwork.
I strongly believe we can win.
I strongly believe every child deserves a good education.
We strongly believe in treating customers fairly.

cards.def:
I claim, with reasons
हिंदी: मेरा तर्क है कि
examples: I would argue that it's too costly.
I would argue that quality matters.
I would argue that remote work makes us more productive.
I would argue that the price is fair for the quality.

cards.def:
the main important idea
हिंदी: मुख्य बिंदु यह है
examples: The key point is timing.
The key point is trust.
The key point is that we must not lose this client.
The key point is to stay calm in the interview.

cards.def:
the central concept
हिंदी: मुख्य विचार
examples: The main idea is to save time.
What's the main idea?
The main idea of the book is that small habits matter.
Write the main idea of your email in the first line.

cards.def:
something illustrating a point
हिंदी: एक अच्छा उदाहरण
examples: A good example is the metro.
Here's a good example.
A good example of teamwork is our last product launch.
Can you give me a good example of a leader you admire?

cards.def:
used to give an example
हिंदी: उदाहरण के लिए
examples: For example, take the bus system.
For example, we could cut costs.
Some foods, for example nuts, are rich in protein.
We could reduce costs, for example by sharing cabs.

cards.def:
to show with an example
हिंदी: स्पष्ट करने के लिए
examples: To illustrate, let me tell a story.
To illustrate, look at this chart.
To illustrate my point, here are last year's numbers.
To illustrate, imagine a shop with no customers on Monday.

cards.def:
used to introduce examples
हिंदी: जैसे कि
examples: Fruits such as apples are healthy.
Many cities, such as Pune, are growing.
Bring documents such as your passport and Aadhaar card.
I enjoy sports such as cricket and badminton.

cards.def:
using X to illustrate
हिंदी: X को उदाहरण मानिए
examples: Take Japan as an example.
Take our team as an example.
Take Kerala as an example of high literacy.
Take my old company as an example of poor planning.

cards.def:
asking someone to picture a situation
हिंदी: कल्पना कीजिए कि
examples: Imagine that you have no phone.
Imagine that prices doubled.
Imagine that you had a whole month off work.
Imagine that the internet went down for a week.

cards.def:
asking someone to visualise
हिंदी: ज़रा सोचिए
examples: Picture this — an empty office.
Picture this scene.
Picture this: a beach, a book and no emails.
Picture this: it's launch day, and the website crashes.

cards.def:
a comparison to explain an idea
हिंदी: उपमा / तुलना
examples: Let me use an analogy.
He drew an analogy with a river.
The teacher used a cooking analogy to explain chemistry.
His analogy between a team and a cricket side made sense.

cards.def:
a figure of speech comparing two things
हिंदी: रूपक
examples: Life is a journey is a metaphor.
He used a metaphor to explain it.
Time is money is a common metaphor in business.
The poem uses the metaphor of a storm for anger.

cards.def:
in order that
हिंदी: ताकि
examples: Speak slowly so that everyone understands.
Save money so that you can travel.
I left early so that I wouldn't miss the train.
Share the agenda so that people can prepare.

cards.def:
for the purpose of
हिंदी: ... के लिए / उद्देश्य से
examples: We cut costs in order to survive.
In order to win, we must practise.
She studied every evening in order to pass the exam.
In order to apply, you need a valid passport.

cards.def:
generally speaking
हिंदी: कुल मिलाकर
examples: On the whole, it went well.
On the whole, I agree.
On the whole, the customers liked the new menu.
There were some problems, but on the whole, the trip was great.

cards.def:
considering everything
हिंदी: कुल मिलाकर
examples: All in all, it was a success.
All in all, I'm happy.
All in all, it was a good year for the company.
The hotel was small, but all in all, we enjoyed our stay.

cards.def:
to finish with a final point
हिंदी: अंत में / निष्कर्ष में
examples: In conclusion, we need to act.
In conclusion, it was worth it.
In conclusion, the new plan will save time and money.
In conclusion, I'd like to thank everyone for their support.

cards.def:
to end with a final point
हिंदी: निष्कर्ष के तौर पर
examples: To conclude, thank you all.
To conclude, we recommend option two.
To conclude, I'd like to share the next steps.
To conclude, the project was a success despite the delays.

cards.def:
most importantly
हिंदी: सबसे पहले और सबसे ज़रूरी
examples: First and foremost, safety matters.
First and foremost, thank you.
First and foremost, I want to thank my parents.
First and foremost, check that the customer is safe.

cards.def:
most importantly
हिंदी: सबसे बढ़कर
examples: Above all, be honest.
Above all, stay calm.
Above all, a good teacher must be patient.
Above all, we want our customers to trust us.

cards.def:
final but equally important
हिंदी: अंतिम किंतु महत्वपूर्ण
examples: Last but not least, thank the team.
And last but not least, our sponsors.
Last but not least, I'd like to thank the cleaning staff.
Last but not least, please fill in the feedback form.

cards.def:
an example that proves a point
हिंदी: इसका एक उदाहरण
examples: Our delay is a case in point.
A case in point is last year's loss.
Traffic in the city is terrible, and this morning was a case in point.
Small shops are struggling; the bakery that closed is a case in point.

cards.def:
the advantages and disadvantages
हिंदी: फ़ायदे और नुकसान
examples: Let's weigh the pros and cons.
The pros and cons are clear.
We discussed the pros and cons of buying a flat.
Every job offer has its pros and cons.

cards.def:
to consider carefully
हिंदी: तौलना / परखना
examples: Weigh up the options first.
She weighed up the risks.
Take time to weigh up both job offers.
We weighed up the cost against the benefits.

cards.def:
a balance of two competing things
हिंदी: समझौता / एक के बदले दूसरा
examples: There's a trade-off between speed and quality.
Every plan has a trade-off.
Living near the office is a trade-off between rent and travel time.
Cheaper flights often come with a trade-off in comfort.

cards.def:
something with both good and bad effects
हिंदी: दोधारी तलवार
examples: Social media is a double-edged sword.
Technology is a double-edged sword.
Working from home is a double-edged sword for many people.
Fame can be a double-edged sword.

cards.def:
the overall view
हिंदी: बड़ी तस्वीर
examples: Let's look at the big picture.
Don't lose sight of the big picture.
Step back and think about the big picture before deciding.
The CEO talks about the big picture, not daily tasks.

cards.def:
a new way of looking at things
हिंदी: नया नज़रिया
examples: She brought a fresh perspective.
We need a fresh perspective.
Travel gives you a fresh perspective on life.
The new manager brought a fresh perspective to old problems.

cards.def:
shared beliefs or interests
हिंदी: साझा आधार
examples: We found common ground.
Let's look for common ground.
The two teams found common ground on the launch date.
Despite their differences, the neighbours found common ground.

cards.def:
a compromise between two extremes
हिंदी: बीच का रास्ता
examples: Let's take a middle path.
The middle path works best.
We took a middle path and worked from the office twice a week.
A middle path between saving and spending keeps life balanced.

cards.def:
to compromise
हिंदी: बीच का रास्ता निकालना
examples: Let's meet halfway on price.
He met me halfway.
I'll meet you halfway and pay half the repair cost.
The landlord met us halfway on the rent increase.

cards.def:
to support with evidence
हिंदी: समर्थन में प्रमाण देना
examples: Can you back that up with data?
He backed up his claim.
Use real examples to back up your answers in the interview.
The scientist backed up her theory with years of data.

cards.def:
facts indicate
हिंदी: प्रमाण संकेत देते हैं
examples: Evidence suggests prices will rise.
Evidence suggests it works.
Evidence suggests that regular walks improve mood.
Evidence suggests the fire started in the kitchen.

cards.def:
as stated by
हिंदी: ... के अनुसार
examples: According to the report, sales fell.
According to him, it's fine.
According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
According to my manager, the bonus will be paid in March.

cards.def:
research indicates
हिंदी: अध्ययन बताते हैं
examples: Studies show sleep helps memory.
Studies show exercise reduces stress.
Studies show that children learn better with play.
Studies show that short breaks improve focus at work.

cards.def:
data indicates
हिंदी: आँकड़े दर्शाते हैं
examples: Statistics show a rise in use.
Statistics show it's growing.
Statistics show that more people are shopping online.
Statistics show that road accidents rise during festivals.

cards.def:
many people think
हिंदी: व्यापक रूप से माना जाता है
examples: It is widely believed that he's right.
It is widely believed to be safe.
It is widely believed that breakfast is the most important meal.
It is widely believed that the company will be sold.

cards.def:
it is obvious
हिंदी: यह कहने की ज़रूरत नहीं
examples: It goes without saying that we need help.
It goes without saying, you're welcome.
It goes without saying that the data must stay private.
It goes without saying that you should arrive on time.

cards.def:
obviously
हिंदी: कहने की ज़रूरत नहीं
examples: Needless to say, we were thrilled.
Needless to say, he won.
Needless to say, the children loved the trip to the zoo.
He forgot the client's name; needless to say, the meeting went badly.

cards.def:
despite what was just said
हिंदी: ऐसा कहने के बाद भी
examples: That being said, we must try.
That being said, it's fine.
The plan is risky. That being said, it could pay off.
The hotel was expensive. That being said, the service was great.

cards.def:
even so
हिंदी: यह कहने के बावजूद
examples: Having said that, it's still risky.
Having said that, I agree.
The job pays well. Having said that, the hours are long.
I love Mumbai; having said that, the rain can be too much.

cards.def:
after reconsidering
हिंदी: दोबारा सोचने पर
examples: On second thought, let's wait.
On second thought, I'll stay.
On second thought, I'll take the stairs.
I said yes, but on second thought, I need more time.

cards.def:
used when an idea suddenly occurs
हिंदी: अब सोचता हूँ तो
examples: Come to think of it, he's right.
Come to think of it, I did see him.
Come to think of it, I haven't eaten since morning.
Come to think of it, the printer has been slow all week.

cards.def:
used when you recall something
हिंदी: अब जब आपने कहा तो
examples: Now that you mention it, I remember.
Now that you mention it, it's true.
Now that you mention it, the room does feel cold.
Now that you mention it, she did look upset in the meeting.

cards.def:
I accept what you say
हिंदी: आपकी बात मान ली
examples: I take your point about cost.
I take your point.
I take your point, but we still need to finish today.
I take your point about the risks; let's plan for them.

cards.def:
accepted as reasonable
हिंदी: ठीक है / वाजिब है
examples: Fair enough, let's do it.
Fair enough, you win.
Fair enough, you can leave early today.
If you want more time, fair enough, but tell the client.

cards.def:
I understand and accept your point
हिंदी: बात समझ गया
examples: Point taken, I'll be careful.
Point taken.
Point taken; I'll include the numbers next time.
Point taken about the noise; we'll keep it down.

cards.def:
I admit I was wrong
हिंदी: मैं अपनी ग़लती मानता हूँ
examples: I stand corrected, you're right.
I stand corrected on that.
I thought the shop closed at eight, but I stand corrected.
I stand corrected; the meeting is on Thursday, not Wednesday.

cards.def:
I'll say it in different words
हिंदी: मैं दूसरे ढंग से कहता हूँ
examples: Let me rephrase the question.
Let me rephrase that.
Sorry, that sounded rude; let me rephrase.
Let me rephrase: what would make this job right for you?

cards.def:
to say it differently
हिंदी: दूसरे ढंग से कहूँ तो
examples: To put it another way, we're out of time.
To put it another way, it failed.
To put it another way, we spend more than we earn.
To put it another way, the customer is always first.

cards.def:
what I'm trying to say
हिंदी: मैं जो कहना चाह रहा हूँ
examples: What I'm getting at is we need change.
Do you see what I'm getting at?
What I'm getting at is that we need more testers.
I'm not sure what you're getting at; can you explain?

cards.def:
what I'm trying to suggest
हिंदी: मेरा इशारा किस ओर है
examples: Do you see what I'm driving at?
That's what I'm driving at.
What I'm driving at is that the process is too slow.
I didn't understand what he was driving at until the end.

cards.def:
to argue persuasively
हिंदी: अपनी बात तर्क से रखना
examples: Let me make my case.
She made her case well.
I'll make my case for a bigger budget at the meeting.
Give me five minutes to make my case.

cards.def:
to persuade people
हिंदी: लोगों को अपने पक्ष में करना
examples: His honesty won people over.
The speech won them over.
The new teacher won people over with her humour.
Free samples helped the shop win people over.

cards.def:
to gain support for an idea
हिंदी: सहमति हासिल करना
examples: We need to get buy-in from the team.
She got buy-in from the board.
Get buy-in from the users before you change the system.
It's easier to get buy-in when people help shape the plan.

cards.def:
to gather people behind an idea
हिंदी: समर्थन जुटाना
examples: He rallied support for the cause.
They rallied support quickly.
The residents rallied support to save the local park.
She rallied support from other managers for the new policy.

cards.def:
to persuade people to accept it
हिंदी: विचार को स्वीकार करवाना
examples: You must sell the idea to the board.
He sold the idea well.
A good story helps you sell an idea to anyone.
He struggled to sell the idea to his parents.
